title: French Mousse
description: A classic French dessert made with gelatin, whipped cream, and aerated chocolate. It's a light and airy treat that's perfect for warm weather.
instructions: Soak the gelatin in 1/4 cup of cold water for 5 minutes.
In a small saucepan, melt the aerated chocolate over low heat, stirring occasionally.
In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
In a separate bowl, mix the soaked gelatin with the Dutch cocoa powder.
Fold the gelatin mixture into the whipped cream until well combined.
Fold the melted chocolate into the whipped cream mixture until well combined.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or until set.
